name: Octree Frustum Culling & LOD Selection
definition: Recursively traverses an octree to cull chunks outside the camera frustum and select appropriate LOD levels based on distance to the camera.
summary: Octree Frustum Culling & LOD Selection uses an octree to efficiently cull invisible voxel chunks and select detail levels, distinguishing itself by integrating distance-based LOD selection during traversal.
